body:
On the web your connectors add **about 16,000 tokens**, all at the 2nd model call. **Vercel alone costs 11,800** (measured: 3 sessions with it denied against 3 without). `deniedMcpServers` in the repository works on the web. `disableClaudeAiConnectors` does **nothing** there.

## The runs (9 new web sessions + this one, Claude Code 2.1.332, environment "Harmonize")
Each probe started on a commit of `cl42` with one prompt: run `true`, then reply "ok" plus the MCP servers it can see. Context = input + cache read + cache creation, read from each session's own events (`list_events`, usage once per message id).

| variant (commit) | run | 1st call | 2nd call | servers it sees |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| A, nothing changed (`a1f898e`) | A1 | 80,515 | 96,684 | (not asked) |
| | A2 | 80,564 | 96,848 | 7 |
| | A3 | 50,463 (*) | 97,465 | 7 |
| B, `deniedMcpServers` Vercel (`c3752bb`) | B1 | 80,544 | 85,298 | 6, no Vercel |
| | B2 | 80,526 | 85,144 | 6, no Vercel |
| | B3 | 80,537 | 85,161 | 6, no Vercel |
| C, `disableClaudeAiConnectors: true` (`695b890`) | C1 | 80,900 | 96,874 | 7 |
| | C2 | 80,560 | 96,702 | 7 |
| | C3 | 80,557 | 96,857 | 7 |
| this session (no probe) | 1 | 80,934 | 97,920 | 7 |

(*) A3 went out before the platform's own tools were loaded (24 tools instead of 59) and missed the cache. That makes 1 run in 10 where the 1st call started with less than the rest, close to the "one in three" you saw on the computer.

**2nd-call mean:** A 96,999 · B 85,201 · C 96,811 (3 runs each). **Vercel = 11,798 tokens**; `disableClaudeAiConnectors` saves 188, which is noise.

## Connectors at start, with their tool counts
| connector | tools | arrives | tokens |
|---|---|---|---|
| Vercel | 287 | 2nd call | **11,798 measured** (A − B) |
| Gmail | 31 | 2nd call | ~1,100 est. |
| Drive | 15 | 2nd call | ~1,000 est. |
| Calendar | 9 | 2nd call | ~400 est. |
| GitHub (the session's repository access, not an account connector) | 48 | 2nd call | ~1,800 est. |
| Docs (Claude Docs) | 8 (3 full schemas, 5 deferred) | **1st call** | ~2,000 est. |
| claude-code-remote (the platform itself) | 35 | 1st call | not a connector |

In all 10 sessions the 1st call ran before the connectors (Docs excepted) had connected. They came in 2 s later and the 2nd call grew by about 16,200 tokens (A: 96,999 − 80,5xx). The per-connector numbers other than Vercel's come from my share-out of that growth by character count (about 0.55 tokens a character). An exact figure per connector needs one "deny" run each.

Why the web costs more than your computer (Vercel 11,800 vs 7,500, all of them about 16,000 vs 10,900): every tool name carries the connector's UUID (`mcp__992a93b1-470f-4dd6-95ed-36e07669d518__list_teams`), so 287 names cost far more.

## Who decides
- **The account** decides which connectors exist. The host injects them (no `--mcp-config`, nothing in the repository).
- **The repository can remove one.** `deniedMcpServers` in its `.claude/settings.json`, read at session start, removed Vercel in 3 of 3 runs. Set mid-session it does nothing (tested in this session: Vercel stayed loadable).
- **`disableClaudeAiConnectors` does not work on the web**: 0 of 3 runs lost a connector.
- **The environment:** "Harmonize" has `allow_mcp_servers: true`. Switching it off is **not measured**: that changes your stored environment.

## What else stops working
With Vercel denied, nothing else was lost in 3 of 3 runs: Docs, Gmail, Drive, Calendar, GitHub and claude-code-remote all still loaded, and `true` ran. Side effect in all 9 probes: the kit's Stop hook made each one take a 3rd turn to refuse a push of about 100 commits it had not made. That is harmless, but it costs one call per probe.

## Not measured
- Network off, another repository, another environment, a connector switched off in the account: each changes a stored setting (environment, account) or needs a repository I may not attach.
- An exact figure for each connector other than Vercel (one deny run each).
- Cost of the 9 probes: about $2.76 (their own `usage.cost_usd`). They are archived. The settings commits on `cl42` are reverted by `cl42`'s next commit (net zero).

## Recommendation
To drop Vercel from every web session of a repository: `"deniedMcpServers": [{"serverName": "992a93b1-470f-4dd6-95ed-36e07669d518"}]` in that repository's `.claude/settings.json` (the server name on the web is the connector's UUID). That saves 11,800 tokens a session.
